name: compact
description: Compact Coach, /handoff, Resume loader and Orchestrator mode: compact at the right moment and keep the thread across it

mod_coach_enabled.title: Compact Coach
mod_coach_enabled.description: Show the compaction cost chip and toast

mod_resume_enabled.title: Resume loader
mod_resume_enabled.description: Remind the model to read the handoff after compaction

mod_orch_enabled.title: Orchestrator mode
mod_orch_enabled.description: Enable /orch and the orchestrator prompt section

mod_nudge_enabled.title: Handoff nudge
mod_nudge_enabled.description: Remind the working model to write its own handoff before compaction (one short note, no extra turn)

coach_showFromTokens.title: Show Coach from (tokens)
coach_showFromTokens.description: Context size from which the chip shows

coach_targetTokens.title: Compaction target (tokens)
coach_targetTokens.description: Wanted size after compaction; the measured floor wins if higher

coach_summaryOutTokens.title: Summary output (tokens)
coach_summaryOutTokens.description: Expected size of the compaction summary

coach_handoffOutTokens.title: Handoff output (tokens)
coach_handoffOutTokens.description: Expected size of the handoff file the model writes

coach_minSavingUsd.title: Minimum saving per turn (USD)
coach_minSavingUsd.description: Below this saving per warm turn the verdict is NOT NOW

coach_strongAt.title: Strong moment score
coach_strongAt.description: Score from which the verdict is GOOD MOMENT

coach_idleReturnMin.title: Idle return (minutes)
coach_idleReturnMin.description: A turn starting after this gap scores +1

coach_toast.title: Coach toast
coach_toast.description: Raise one toast per strong moment

coach_passAssumesCacheHit.title: Compaction pass hits warm cache
coach_passAssumesCacheHit.description: Price the compaction pass at cache-read rates when the cache is warm (set false if a real compaction shows otherwise)

pricesJson.title: Prices override (JSON)
pricesJson.description: Optional per-family price overrides, USD per MTok; empty keeps the built-in table

cache_expiringSec.title: Cache expiring (seconds)
cache_expiringSec.description: Seconds before expiry from which the cache counts as expiring

handoff_confirmTtlMin.title: Confirm window (minutes)
handoff_confirmTtlMin.description: How long /handoff go stays available after the file is ready

handoff_resumeMaxAgeMin.title: Resume window (minutes)
handoff_resumeMaxAgeMin.description: A handoff saved longer ago than this is not used to resume

nudge_atPercent.title: Nudge from (% of window)
nudge_atPercent.description: First nudge at this percent of the auto-compact window (10 to 95)

nudge_everyTokens.title: Nudge again every (tokens)
nudge_everyTokens.description: Another nudge each time context grows by this much (minimum 10000)

orch_enabled.title: Orchestrator default
orch_enabled.description: First-run default for Orchestrator mode; /orch overrides it once used

minBandRows.title: Minimum band rows
minBandRows.description: The band stays silent when fewer rows are free

windowsJson.title: Context windows override
windowsJson.description: JSON {"asOf":"YYYY-MM-DD","sonnet":200000,"opus":1000000} tokens per family (or a model-id substring). Empty = built-in table.
